description: Defines the HdrLayerInfoReporter class and related structures for managing HDR layer information and listeners in Android's surfaceflinger service.

classes.name: HdrLayerInfoReporter
classes.description: Manages HDR layer information reporting and listener registration for surfaceflinger.

classes.name: HdrLayerInfo
classes.description: Stores HDR layer metrics such as count, dimensions, flags, and desired HDR-SDR ratio.

methods.name: dispatchHdrLayerInfo
methods.description: Dispatches updated HDR layer info to registered listeners.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Handles death of binder objects, as part of IBinder::DeathRecipient.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a new HDR layer info listener.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Deregisters an existing HDR layer info listener.

methods.name: hasListeners
methods.description: Checks if there are any registered listeners.
